ana-s: Hey team — presales ask from FinCorp. They want a short POC (2 weeks) but have strict EU-only data residency + list of subprocessors + routing path assertion for auditors. Also asked for egress certs and a quick cost delta for hosted vs dedicated. Ping @mike-p and @jamal-ops :eyes:
mike-p: Thanks — a few quick q's: which model family are they testing (L/R)? expected peak RPS? Are they asking BYO-KMS or OK with our KMS?
ana-s: They said standard redwood-gpt-medium for now, 20 rps peak, burst to 80 for short windows. They want BYO-KMS option scoped in the quote.
jamal-ops: We can do EU-only tenancy. Current GA regions for that footprint: eu-west-1 (Ireland), eu-central-1 (Frankfurt), eu-north-1 (Stockholm). Subprocessor inventory: AWS (ec2, s3), Cloudflare (CDN), Sentry (errors), Datadog (metrics). I can attach the cert and SOC links. :+1:
jamal-ops: Routing policy note: default is region-fallback -> we can pin tenant with geofence tag + static routing policy. Example config snippet:```json
{
  "tenant_id": "fincorp-poc",
  "geofence": "eu-west-1",
  "fallback": "no-fallback"
}
```
elaine-se: On pricing: egress differences — hosted (multi-tenant) estimate: +€0.03/token egress overhead vs Dedicated (reserved) where egress is billed at cost plus margin — roughly €0.008/token but commit required. For a 2-week POC we'll likely recommend hosted with a short dedicated trial if latency/throughput needs spike.
mike-p: Can we provide the subprocessors list as a signed attestation and include the routing path diagram for auditors? They asked for certs (ISO27001, SOC2) and network flow showing no cross-border hops.
jamal-ops: I will export subprocessors + SOC/ISO cert links. For network flow, we can generate a simple path diagram and an engineered statement: "All control-plane and inference traffic for tenant pinned to eu-west-1; no cross-border egress." Need legal to sign the attestation though.
nana-s: Who owns getting legal sign-off?
mike-p: I'll own the attestation track with Legal. @elaine-se can you add the POC cost delta to the quote template and include BYO-KMS add-on pricing?
elaine-se: Yep. I'll drop numbers into the quote doc and add a tidy comparison table. Will also flag SLA differences (hosted no uptime SLA; Dedicated has SLA & penalty).
autoscale-bot: deployment note: artifact fincorp-poc-config v1 uploaded to staging at 2023-11-09T14:22Z
jamal-ops: Next steps: (1) jamal-ops -> attach subproc inventory + cert links (2) mike-p -> legal attestation kickoff (3) elaine-se -> updated POC quote with BYO-KMS + egress deltas (4) ana-s -> customer sync & schedule kickoff. ETA 24-48h.
mike-p: +1. I'll loop Legal and post updates here. :thumbsup:
ana-s: Thanks team — will schedule customer call once we have attestation draft.
